rationale: iter-71: swa_last_n 6 -> 4 (skip first 2 epochs of per-step SWA averaging) on iter-67 substrate. Headroom 0.6044 -> 0.6052 (+0.08pp). KEEP. NEW MAIN BEST. Skipping early-epoch weights (when model is still under-trained) lets SWA average only mature-iterate snapshots, giving cleaner averaging. Per-step samples in last 4 epochs: ~1600 vs ~2400 at full-window — fewer but higher-quality samples.
advice_for_others: swa_last_n=4 narrows the averaging window to high-quality late-training snapshots; +0.08pp on NAFNet substrate vs the iter-67 full-window baseline. Predicted: swa_last_n=2 or 3 either tighter window benefits or starves SWA of samples. Worth bisecting.
